v1.0.10 - Kasarani Music Center Live Classroom Update
- Native In-App Virtual Classroom powered by Agora RTC Engine
- High-Fidelity acoustic audio and HD live masterclass video streaming from faculty studio
- Interactive 'Raise Hand' microphone uplink for live student Q&A and performance review
- Built-in studio practice tools: digital metronome (BPM tap tempo) and concert pitch tuner
- Real-time Supabase live session indicator & timetable quick-join
